Headline: Gate Prediction Markets CS2 Trading Challenge: Rewards for the First Trade, Loss Compensation, and a...
Prize pool: 10K USDT
Start: 2026-11-23T08:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-14T08:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 150 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 100 USDT (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
The Gate Prediction Markets CS2 Trading Challenge is now live, featuring CS2 tournaments such as the Singapore Major. Sign up to predict CS2 results and complete the required trading and Scratch Card tasks. New users can earn a 20 USDT first-trade reward. New and existing users who meet the net loss and other requirements can receive 20 USDT in compensation. Users can also compete on the prediction trading leaderboard, with a total of 30,000 USDT available across the three benefits. Eligible users can combine all three benefits with their Scratch Card rewards.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 23, 2026, 08:00 (UTC) – December 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## How to Join and Which Trades Qualify
Click [Join Now] on the event page to sign up, then participate in CS2 event predictions on Gate Prediction Markets.
This event counts all CS2 event predictions made after signing up during the event period, including predictions related to individual matchups, maps, and event champions in various competitions, not limited to Majors. Trading volume from predictions of non-CS2 events, including other games, sports, and crypto, is not counted.
Only executed trades made with your own funds count. Trading volume, positions, and PnL generated using Prediction Markets Trading Vouchers or other subsidized funds are excluded from this event's trading volume, first-trade reward, and loss compensation calculations.
For every 20 USDT in cumulative eligible CS2 prediction trading volume during this event, you can receive one Event Points Scratch Card. To qualify for each benefit, you must meet the trading requirements and use the minimum required number of valid Scratch Cards.
## Benefit 1: New Users, Meet the First-Trade Requirement to Claim 20 USDT
During the event, new users who register can qualify if their first Gate Prediction Markets order is a CS2 prediction order with an executed buy amount funded by their own money, after deducting trading fees, of at least 100 USDT, and they use at least five valid Scratch Cards. They can then claim a 20 USDT new user reward. Limited to the first 500 qualifying new users.
## Participation Rules
New users are those who have never completed any prediction trades on Gate Prediction Markets at the time of signing up, including users who have registered with Gate but have never completed a prediction trade on Prediction Markets.
The first-trade threshold is based on the executed buy amount funded by your own money, after deducting trading fees. Partial fills of the same first order can be combined, but fills from different orders cannot. If the amount after fees is below 100 USDT, the requirement is not met.
Rewards are limited to the first 500 users who pass verification, in the order they meet both the first-order amount requirement and the requirement to use at least five valid Scratch Cards. Each user can claim the reward once.
## Benefit 2: Loss Compensation of 20 USDT per User
During the event, registered users can qualify with cumulative eligible CS2 prediction trading volume of at least 1,000 USDT, at least 50 valid Scratch Cards used, and a cumulative realized net loss on eligible positions of at least 20 USDT. Qualifying users can claim 20 USDT in loss compensation, available to a maximum of 500 users.
Participation Rules: Only the overall net loss of CS2 positions held with users' own funds after signing up is calculated. Profits and losses are offset against each other. Among users who meet all requirements, the first 500 ranked by cumulative valid trading volume from highest to lowest will receive the compensation. In the event of equal trading volume, earlier sign-up takes priority.
## Benefit 3: Compete on the CS2 Trading Leaderboard to Share 10,000 USDT
During the event, registered users with cumulative eligible CS2 prediction trading volume of at least 5,000 USDT who use at least 250 valid Scratch Cards qualify for the final rankings.
Users are ranked by cumulative eligible trading volume from highest to lowest. The top 500 qualify for the following reward tiers based on their final ranking, trading volume, and the number of valid Scratch Cards used:
Rank | Minimum Cumulative Eligible Trading Volume | Minimum Number of Scratch Cards Used | Prize Pool
1st–5th Place | At least 600,000 USDT | At least 30,000 uses | Share 3,000 USDT
6th–20th Place | At least 400,000 USDT | At least 20,000 uses | Share 2,000 USDT, up to 150 USDT per user
21st–500th Place | At least 5,000 USDT | At least 250 uses | Share 5,000 USDT, up to 50 USDT per user
## Reward Calculation and Tier Downgrade Rules
Users must meet both the trading volume and actual Scratch Card count requirements for their respective tier. Users who do not meet the conditions for the initial tier will be automatically downgraded to the highest reward tier for which both conditions are met, and will share the reward distribution with users who originally qualified for that tier. Users ranked below 500th place in the final ranking will not participate in the reward distribution. When users have the same cumulative valid trading volume, the user who reached that volume earlier will receive the higher ranking.
Individual reward = individual cumulative eligible trading volume ÷ total cumulative prediction trading volume of all users in the tier × the tier's prize pool, subject to that tier's per-user reward cap.
No additional per-user reward cap applies to ranks 1–5; the actual reward per user is capped at 150 USDT for ranks 6–20 and 50 USDT for ranks 21–500.
## Scratch Card Task Details
For every 20 USDT in cumulative eligible CS2 prediction trading volume during this event, you can receive one Event Points Scratch Card. Scratch Cards earned in other prediction categories also count toward this event. To receive each benefit, you must use the minimum required number of valid Scratch Cards.
If you use Scratch Cards in bulk, the number of uses is calculated based on the actual number of eligible Scratch Cards used. For example, using 10 eligible Scratch Cards at once counts as 10 Scratch Card uses.
rewards from this campaign cannot be combined with Prediction Points campaign leaderboard rewards.
For more details, see: Gate Prediction Markets: Event Points Now Live — Trade to Earn Scratch Cards and Unlock Multiple Rewards, with Draws Every Monday
## Prediction Markets Trading Voucher Usage Rules
All rewards from this event, including new user first-trade rewards, loss compensation, and leaderboard rewards, are issued as Prediction Markets Trading Vouchers. Vouchers cannot be withdrawn directly and can only be used to trade on the platform's Prediction Markets.
The profit generated from using Prediction Markets Trading Vouchers to participate in predictions may be withdrawn in accordance with the product rules.
Prediction Markets Trading Vouchers must be used within the validity period shown on the voucher. Any unused amount expires automatically. See the voucher for applicable markets, validity, and rules on how profits are handled.
## Important Notes
Participants must click [Join Now] on the event page to register and complete Identity Verification to receive rewards. This activity is open only to designated users who meet the eligibility requirements. If registration is unavailable on the page, your account is not currently eligible to participate. Refer to the event page for the information displayed there.
Only eligible trades generated from CS2 event predictions in Gate Prediction Markets after registration during the activity period will be counted. Only trades made with users' own funds count toward this activity. Trading volume, positions, and PnL corresponding to Prediction Markets Trading Vouchers and other subsidized funds are excluded.
Eligible trading volume is based on the value of executed prediction trades, including Yes purchases, No purchases, and secondary-market sales, excluding trading fees. Unfilled orders, unfilled portions of canceled orders, transfers, refunds, and abnormal trades do not count. The qualifying first-trade amount is verified separately using the amount after fees, as specified under Benefit 1.
The cumulative realized net loss for Benefit 2 is calculated across all CS2 prediction positions bought with your own funds after registration during the event. Related profits, losses, and actual trading fees are included. Positions held before the event, shares bought after it ends, event rewards, compensation, deposits, withdrawals, and PnL from other categories are excluded.
Unrealized losses from positions that have not been closed or settled are not used as the basis for actual net loss compensation. They will be calculated together after the relevant positions are sold or finally settled. Sales or settlements after the activity ends are used only to confirm the final PnL of positions included in the original activity statistics and do not count toward the activity's eligible trading volume. Trades fully refunded due to market cancellation or other reasons are excluded from eligible trading volume and loss compensation calculations.
Campaign rewards will be distributed within 14 business days. If relevant matches are postponed or market settlement is delayed, reward distribution will be deferred accordingly.
Campaign rewards and Prediction Points Scratch Card rewards can be combined under their respective rules. Users who also participate in other Gate trading reward campaigns of the same type will not receive duplicate rewards across campaigns. Eligibility is subject to Gate’s system assessment and the rules on the respective campaign pages.
The total campaign reward pool may not be distributed in full. Prediction Points Scratch Card rewards are distributed under separate rules and are not included in this campaign’s prize pool.
Only one eligible main account per verified identity may participate. Subaccounts, API users, users at VIP 15 or above, market makers, corporate accounts, institutional accounts, and restricted accounts are not eligible.
If an event is postponed, canceled, rescheduled, or interrupted, if rulings change, markets close, or other force majeure circumstances arise, Gate may adjust, suspend, or cancel the relevant markets and event rewards based on the circumstances.
Gate Prediction Markets services may be subject to the laws and regulations of the user's jurisdiction. Users must comply with the Gate User Agreement. Before participating, users should confirm the laws and regulations in their jurisdiction, the platform's terms of service, and their risk tolerance to ensure that they are eligible to participate. Users in restricted regions may be unable to use some or all services, including registration, trading, making predictions, claiming rewards, or participating in this event.
This event is not marketed to users in regions where Prediction Markets, predictions, contracts for difference, derivatives, or crypto asset trading are prohibited or restricted. Users must not use VPNs, proxies, false identities, third parties acting on their behalf, or other means to bypass regional restrictions, KYC requirements, or platform risk control rules.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
Gate reserves the right to adjust, suspend, or cancel the event rules, prize pool, reward distribution method, eligibility requirements, or event period based on market conditions, changes to tournaments, system issues, compliance requirements, or force majeure. Any changes will be announced on the event page. Gate reserves the right to interpret the terms of this event. This event is not affiliated with Apple Inc.

OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
The Gate Square Comment Challenge is back for Round 2. A 10,000 USDT prize pool awaits every week.
Join the conversation for a chance to earn USDT rewards and Gate merch. No lengthy essays needed. Share genuine views, useful information or personal experiences for a chance to earn rewards.
## Event Period: November 23, 2026, 02:00 – December 6, 2026, 14:00 (UTC)
## Reward 1: First Comment Bonus, Earn 10 USDT
Register for this round, then post your first valid comment under another user’s Gate Square post to receive a 10 USDT Futures Position Voucher.
Open to new and existing users, including participants and winners from the previous round.
“First comment” means your first valid comment after registering for this round, not your account’s first-ever comment.
Each user may claim this reward once during this round.
Eligible comments may also count toward other rewards.
## Reward 2: Daily Comment Check-In, Win Up to 100 USDT Weekly
Make your daily comments count toward rewards! After registering, post at least 1 valid comment under another user’s post each day to earn 1 qualifying day.
Consecutive days are not required. Reach 2 qualifying days in a week to unlock rewards. The more days you participate, the higher your reward!
Qualifying Days per Week | Reward
2 days | 20 USDT Futures Position Voucher
3 days | 30 USDT Futures Position Voucher
4 days | 40 USDT Futures Position Voucher
5 days | 50 USDT Futures Position Voucher
6 days | 60 USDT Futures Position Voucher
7 days | 100 USDT Futures Position Voucher
## Weekly 10,000 USDT Prize Pool
Each week offers 10,000 USDT in Futures Position Vouchers. Reward priority follows the order in which users first reach 2 qualifying days that week, based on the publication time of their first valid comment on the second qualifying day. Rewards are distributed in that order after verification, while the pool lasts.
## Reward Upgrade Rules
Each user receives only the highest reward tier reached that week. Tiers do not stack.
For example, 5 qualifying days earn 50 USDT; 7 qualifying days upgrade the reward to 100 USDT.
Rewards are calculated separately each week, with participation resetting weekly. Rewards are distributed every Monday.
## Reward 3: Quality Comment Awards, Win 5 USDT + Gate Merch Weekly
Great comments stand out through insight and value, not just volume.
After registering, post valid comments or replies under other users’ posts to enter the quality comment selection. No separate submission or check-in requirement applies.
Each week, Gate will publish a shortlist of quality commenters, featuring representative comments and the reasons for their selection.
## Weekly Rewards
Award | Recipients | Reward
Quality Comment Award | 5 users | 5 USDT each
Merch Surprise Award | 5 users | 1 Gate merch prize each
## What Makes a Comment Stand Out?
Add insight: Support or expand on the post’s specific claims with evidence, missing information or a different perspective.
Share experience: Describe your own decisions, outcomes or lessons learned.
Ask questions: Raise relevant questions that explore the post in more depth.
Advance the discussion: Respond to other users’ views and explain why you agree or disagree.
Throughout the event, Gate will showcase quality comments to help you understand the selection criteria. Join discussions on recommended posts or choose topics that interest you for a chance to earn extra rewards!
